content_sections.heading: KSIDC Recruitment 2026 - 10 Vacancies
content_sections.text: Kerala State Industrial Development Corporation Limited has advertised 10 vacancies under six category notifications. Category No. 035/2026 advertises five Business Development Executive positions on a contractual basis. Candidates need Graduation in any discipline with MBA, preferably in Marketing or Finance, and at least two years of relevant post-qualification experience. The maximum age is 35 years. Selected candidates will receive Rs. 30,000 per month. The contract is initially for one year and may be extended. Category No. 029/2026 advertises one Chief Financial Officer position. Candidates must be members of ICAI or the Institute of Cost Accountants of India, with at least 15 years of post-qualification experience, including four years in RBI-regulated banks, NBFCs or financial institutions. The age requirement is 38 to 62 years. The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 3,00,000 per month. The contract is for three years, extendable by another two years. The Technical Advisor (Civil) position requires a Civil Engineering Degree and 15 years of post-qualification experience. Recently retired Civil Engineers at Executive Engineer level or above from relevant Government departments are highly preferred. The MEP Engineer position requires a Degree in Mechanical or Electrical and Electronics Engineering with three years of experience in MEP works involving infrastructure or building projects.

content_sections.heading: Kerala State Textile Corporation Recruitment 2026 - 18 Posts
content_sections.text: Kerala State Textile Corporation Limited has announced 18 contractual vacancies covering spinning operations, electrical maintenance, personnel management, commercial functions and general management. The corporation has advertised 10 Supervisor/Shift In Charge (Spinning) vacancies and three Supervisor (Electrical) vacancies. Applicants require the relevant Engineering Degree or Diploma. Degree holders generally need one year of prescribed experience, while Diploma holders need two years. The maximum age is 36 years and monthly remuneration is Rs. 25,000. Two General Manager positions are available under Category No. 022/2026. Candidates must possess BE/B.Tech or Diploma in Textile Technology. Degree holders need at least 12 years of post-qualification textile mill experience, including five years in a Manager Grade position. Diploma holders need at least 15 years, including five years in Manager Grade. The maximum age is 45 years and consolidated remuneration is Rs. 80,000 per month.

content_sections.heading: Kerala Public Enterprises Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The KPESRB notifications provide for selection through the written examination, skill test or interview, as applicable. However, they do not prescribe one identical selection procedure for all 17 categories. The Board will communicate recruitment-stage details to eligible candidates through the registered email address, mobile number and official website. Applications and participation in subsequent selection stages will remain provisional until the Board verifies eligibility and credentials. Important: The supplied notifications do not provide a common written examination date, syllabus, examination pattern or interview schedule for these 33 vacancies. Candidates should follow the category-specific selection announcements.

content_sections.heading: Kerala Public Enterprises Recruitment 2026 Contract and Permanent Jobs
content_sections.text: The recruitment includes both permanent and contractual positions. Applicants should understand the distinction before applying. These are the two positions expressly identified as permanent in the merged notifications. The remaining 31 vacancies are contractual, including Business Development Executive, Legal Officer, Advisor, Chief Financial Officer, Supervisor, General Manager and the other advertised positions. Several contracts are initially for one year and extendable according to performance or organizational requirements. The KSIDC Chief Financial Officer contract is for three years, extendable by another two years, while KTDFC Assistant Manager (Accounts) has an initial two-year contract.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Kerala Public Enterprises Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official KPESRB website at kpesrb.kerala.gov.in . Open the Vacancy and Notification section. Find the relevant recruitment category number between 020/2026 and 036/2026. Download the detailed notification for the selected position. Read the educational qualification, age, experience, salary and fee requirements. Open the official KPESRB online recruitment portal . Complete One-Time Registration if you are a new applicant. Log in using the prescribed credentials. Update personal, contact, qualification and experience details. Select the required category number and post. Upload educational qualification certificates. Upload mandatory experience certificates. Upload reservation or equivalence certificates, where applicable. Verify that all uploaded documents are readable and accurate. Pay the applicable category-specific application fee. Review the completed application carefully. Submit the online application before 19 December 2026 . Save and print the submitted application for future reference. Keep the registered email address and mobile number active for recruitment communications. Important: The notifications explicitly state that failure to upload essential qualification and experience certificates will result in rejection of the application.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Kerala Public Enterprises Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants should keep the following documents ready, as applicable to their selected position: Proof of date of birth. Educational qualification certificates and marksheets. Engineering Degree or Diploma certificates, where applicable. MBA, MSW or other postgraduate qualification certificates. CA or CMA membership and qualification records, where applicable. Institute of Company Secretaries of India membership certificate, where applicable. LLB qualification certificate, where applicable. Essential post-qualification experience certificates. Equivalency certificate for equivalent qualifications, where required. SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate, where applicable. Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where required. Valid identity proof. Photograph and signature, according to portal instructions. Application fee payment confirmation. Any additional documents specified in the category-wise notification. Original certificates may be required during the subsequent recruitment stages. Candidates must submit accurate information because eligibility discrepancies can lead to rejection even after shortlisting.
